description: WHM scoped private configuration in root scope for any WHM caller. Never log input or returned configuration values, including raw mismatch payloads.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 86 and later. Scope names and returned string-valued configuration maps are private data. The pinned source marks this retrieval x-readonly=false. Review 5721307565 (https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/70#pullrequestreview-5721307565) on cPanel 11.138.0.19 inspected UserData.pm: new_scoped uses root for any WHM caller and ensure_dirs creates directories under /var/cpanel/userdata/root/scope/ when the requested scope does not exist. It is not a pure read.

Client policy: use one form POST without automatic retry or rollback and forward the exact supplied scope. Returned dynamic map values retain the pinned strict string contract; null or missing root payloads fail.

This read observation does not establish the write response contract.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 86 and later. Creates or updates scoped configuration and returns the full updated map. Supply either pre-serialized json text or key/value arguments: upstream says json cannot be combined with key or value. Omitted optional arguments have no documented default. Scope, key, value, JSON text and returned private configuration are sensitive. Review 5721307565 (https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/70#pullrequestreview-5721307565) on cPanel 11.138.0.19 inspected UserData.pm: new_scoped uses root for any WHM caller; arbitrary JSON values are assigned and the in-memory data map is returned after saving. This source-based write contract permits nested JSON values and differs from the pinned string-valued read map. The reviewer did not run a write.

Client policy: use one form POST without automatic retry or rollback. The client forwards supplied arguments without a cross-field validator and form-encodes raw JSON text exactly once; it does not accept a PHP object or send a JSON request body. Optional null arguments are omitted. Exact supplied strings are forwarded, including zero, without promising server acceptance: empty key, value or json and missing/conflicting inputs are upstream API errors. Root payloads must remain objects; null/missing roots fail.
